dataVersion.policy: Preserve baseline-exact validation controls first; then exact boards, macro recall and loss. Distill only previous training photos, never validation or newly targeted photos.

metadata.selection: maximum designated validation control exact boards first; maximum validation exact boards, then macro recall, then lower unweighted loss; earlier tie
metadata.loss: cross entropy with inverse class frequency from training only

initialization.optimizer: new AdamW; previous optimizer state is not inherited

distillation.scope: teacher predictions on designated training squares only; no validation/evaluation targets

photographicValidation.memoryScope: Comparison process including both models, imports, indexes and records; not model-only.
